mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing consumer demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic output.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, which may lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals growing consumer demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which may lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased liquidity.
